Reprint of the Andrew Ellicott 1792 map of Washington D.C. At head of title: To front p. 636. At bottom: Engraved for Encyclopædia Perthensis. Differs from other 1792 ed. (76-696408) in having the Encyclopædia Perthensis statement at bottom of plate. At upper right: Plate III. Watermark: 1794. Includes text. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copy backed with rice paper [?], has paper strip affixed to verso, trimmed. Vault Acquisitions control no.: 98-22 DCP
